# Pullfrog: review-only operation

This repository uses Pullfrog only as a GitHub reviewer. Console settings, the
workflow, the shared review instructions, and review completion are maintained
in the [MDGChamomile repository](https://github.com/MDGChamomile/MDGChamomile/blob/main/PULLFROG.md).
That file is the single source of truth; make changes there rather than here.

## Review focus (console)

Paste this after the shared review instructions:

> Preserve local/web separation, canonical scope, tool provenance, resource
> budgets, cancellation/cleanup, readiness, bounded output, and content-free
> telemetry.
